about

Built by practitioners, not just trainers

Bharat School of Cyber Security exists to close a simple gap: colleges teach cybersecurity theory, but most students graduate without ever running a real attack or defending a live system. We bring that hands-on layer directly into campuses: using the college's own classrooms and labs, taught by people who work in security every day.

Our founding team combines operational scale: building and growing an edtech organisation from a handful of people to a 15,000+ employee institution: with frontline security experience across government infrastructure, national research institutions, and enterprise assessments.

We're early: and deliberately so. Rather than mass-market online courses, we're building deep, in-person partnerships with a small number of colleges first.

what we offer

Programs across the full security skills spectrum

SC

Short-Term Courses

Focused bootcamps of one to a few weeks: built around a single skill, like network defence or web app pentesting.

LC

Long-Term Courses

Our flagship 6-month, practitioner-led track: fundamentals through to a capstone project and certification prep.

FD

Faculty Development Programs

Upskilling sessions for college faculty, so security knowledge stays current inside the institution, not just with us.

LT

Leadership Training

Security-aware decision-making for department heads and institutional leadership: the questions to ask, the risks to weigh.

CS

CISO Program

An executive-track program for students and professionals aiming at security leadership roles, not just technical ones.

CT

Certifications

Structured prep for CEH, ISO/IEC 27001 LA, CompTIA Security+, CCNA and other recognised industry certifications.

RT

Red Team Solutions

Offensive security training and services: penetration testing, vulnerability assessment, and adversary simulation.

BT

Blue Team Solutions

Defensive security training and services: SOC operations, threat detection, incident response and forensics.

Certification pathways we prepare students for

CEH: EC-Council ISO/IEC 27001 (LA) CompTIA Security+ CCNA: Cisco AWS Certified Security Certified SOC Analyst eJPT / eWPTX
